digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text cutover and state-based echo suppression
propositions: Cloud and DC send paths must route through rich-text codecs with echo suppression by state-based baseline comparison rather than codec round-trip identity
DC's WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound must be redefined as decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) to restore the codec law and render wiki on both CREATE and UPDATE paths

A no-op pass (local unchanged from baseline) must suppress outbound emission and incur zero baseline writes, with state tracked via an inline change-gated 8-byte rich_sha counter reset on any wire diff
Concurrent both-sides edits of description preserve local-wins semantics while raising outbound-field-conflict alert
The cutover must degrade to plain-text ADF behaviour when marklas is absent, returning existing fallback rather than raising error

Two distinct compares coexist: emit compares normalized remote (via decode_inbound) against local; baseline compares normalize-outbound local against decoded baseline, with lone normalizer at OutboundFieldMapper
